actual_reader.operation: Read source text, SHA256 complete files, and git show comparison only; no application module imports.

current_safe_boundary.decision: Keep the current Pro restart/resume/reallocation refusal; do not replace it with an unqualified direct Core API call.
current_safe_boundary.established_scope: The C2e2d handoff product tests establish the external standalone command/API issuer path. This read-only review adds no product execution evidence.
current_safe_boundary.not_established: A supervised Director script role transferring a long-lived successor out of its own ancestor supervisor tree.

local_context_limit.statement: current_controller() returning None only passes the local registered-controller guard. It does not prove the issuer has no external ancestor supervisor.

facts.statement: The generated Director runs director_role.py as a script role with --once and a 120-second role timeout.
The Pro role path creates an owned supervised process, retains its supervision owner, and sends GO only after its durable handoff.
Role harvest requires tree closure; role timeout invokes owner.abort. The worker supervisor reports TREE_CLOSED only after its wait-all proof and signals owned children when stopping.
Core handoff launches the successor with subprocess.Popen and start_new_session=True in the issuer process.

findings.inference: If that issuer is the managed Director role, the successor is born within the role's supervised descendant tree. A successful controller STARTED record does not itself transfer that ancestor ownership. The role may remain unclosed after --once returns, and role timeout/STOP may subsequently reach the accepted successor.
findings.consequence: Do not advertise managed Director handoff support based on the external issuer tests. setsid, double-forking or clearing environment variables is not an ownership transfer.
findings.implementation_constraint: The next phase needs a durable decision consumed by an explicitly authorized owner in the existing framework control scheduling layer, or an explicit ownership-transfer protocol in that framework. Do not introduce a separate background broker microservice.

facts.statement: Task execution derives task_dir from project_dir/tasks_dir/task. The current stop command uses that cwd and implicit orze.yaml; the existing evidence loader also selects task_dir/orze.yaml.
The evidence loader removes the default primary_metric if it was not explicitly authored and normalizes paths/derived environment entries. It restores cwd/environment on leaving its context.

The actual loader stamps the config path, working directory and profile fingerprint. The fingerprint includes public config, canonical path inputs, loader-derived environment paths and physical GPU declaration.
Handoff verifies the original stamp and current cwd, and witnesses the actual config file, scope and database route.

findings.consequence: Do not pass director_evidence._child_config's modified evidence projection as handoff authority or regenerate a stamp to make it fit. An authorized future control executor must load the original config in its actual task cwd and preserve that context through the call. If the original config path/cwd cannot be established, HOLD rather than guess an alternate path.

facts.statement: The Director cooldown is an in-memory dictionary keyed by action/task/the first 40 message characters, with a 30-minute lifetime. It is not a durable handoff request identity.
Current action bookkeeping records success based on a result string not starting with blocked:, including the rule-based offline restart path.
Core first checks the stable request ID. An existing non-STARTED grant is held; an existing STARTED grant is verified and returned without another Popen.
CompletedControllerHandoff carries request/grant/source/target/generation/started digest and deliberately refuses Boolean interpretation.

findings.consequence: Before any future control call, durably bind a stable request ID to the selected decision, original source/head and exact scope/config. Retain that ID through unknown results. Do not use a fresh timestamp/random ID on retry or derive the retry ID only from the now-current head: a lost final reply may already have advanced that head. Record a verified typed completion once, with its exact grant/target/generation/digest, not a CLI return code or a generic result label.
findings.stop_order: Do not call the current stop-only helper before handing off to restart_controller. Core must capture and stop the live old controller itself.
findings.excluded_actions: Offline/resume/reallocation and changed-cwd/config/GPU assignment are outside the proposed narrow live same-config V2 restart and remain HOLD.

precise_reviewed_example.finding: The fresh copied-script case imports the copy and checks generated child state. It does not exercise that script as a supervised role through a controller handoff. The adjacent cases explicitly preserve existing operator-owned copied files.

existing_test_context.limitation: No copied Director deployment is silently upgraded by this review, and no existing test result is reattributed to managed-role handoff support.

proposed_minimum_sequence: Keep current refusal while choosing an explicit control-action owner within the existing framework. Treat the managed Director as a durable decision producer until the ownership boundary is proved.
Limit admission to an explicitly authorized live V2 source with the same task cwd, original config and GPU declaration. Preserve all current unknown/offline/resume/reallocation refusals.
Persist the decision/request binding before control, use the original loader context, and have the approved owner invoke the existing Core handoff exactly once per durable request.
Consume only the verified typed handoff result into once-only Director action accounting; preserve unknown grant/request state without replacement launch.
Prove the real supervised-role composition or explicit transfer separately before exposing it as supported. Do not infer it from a local context lookup or external standalone success.

proposed_tests_not_executed.name: approved_owner_live_same_config_restart
proposed_tests_not_executed.purpose: Actual same-cwd V2 source to successor through the selected existing-framework owner, real CPU supervision/SQLite/pidfds, with GPU/provider boundaries explicitly isolated. This is a new integration requirement, not an old missing-API red.

proposed_tests_not_executed.name: managed_role_successor_ancestor_boundary
proposed_tests_not_executed.purpose: Actual generated --once script role, descendant successor and role harvest/timeout using only authenticated owned pidfds. Check that accepted successor lifetime is not silently controlled by the prior role tree; execute only after explicit scope/ownership design approval.

proposed_tests_not_executed.name: durable_reply_loss_and_config_refusal
proposed_tests_not_executed.purpose: Lost final reply must reuse the same durable request without another launch or duplicate success accounting; changed config/cwd/head binding and offline/reallocation remain HOLD. These are proposed new mechanisms, not observed failures.
